# AWF maintenance

Use `agentic-implementing` for general implementation discipline. This skill owns AWF's generated-source and upgrade behavior. Treat `.awf/` as source and rendered trees as generated. Edit the source first, render, inspect drift, and keep source, generated output, and lock changes together.

<!-- awf:edit generated-documents: default; create .awf/skills/parts/awf-maintenance/generated-documents.md to override -->
## Generated documents

Do not hand-edit generated output, except the declared local document body after its `awf:edit-in-place` pointer. For generated prose, inspect produced boundaries for contradictions, stale paraphrases, and intentional literal placeholders. Keep content with its source and run the repository's render and check commands.

Declare repository-specific documents through `localDocs`. Removing a declaration or uninstalling refuses when a present local document contains protected authored content; reconcile that path explicitly before rerunning.

<!-- awf:edit upgrades: default; create .awf/skills/parts/awf-maintenance/upgrades.md to override -->
## Upgrades

Use the supported bootstrap path. Retained skill overrides migrate to their fixed AWF identities; a migration refuses protected overrides that it cannot prove safe to move or remove. Inspect reported paths and Git state after a partial failure, correct the blocking condition, and rerun the ordinary upgrade. Preserve unrelated content. Never substitute a generated-tree edit for source repair.
